vision: Transform the existing Hive-based data warehouse into a modern, high-performance Delta Lakehouse on Databricks to deliver ACID-compliant, unified batch and streaming analytics with improved data reliability, faster queries, and seamless BI integration.
scope: The migration covers 500+ Hive tables (200 TB), 150 Airflow ETL jobs, 50 BI dashboards, and real-time streams. Key features include Delta Lake ACID transactions, time travel, schema evolution, and query optimization via Z-ordering. Backward compatibility and zero dashboard downtime are mandatory.
success_criteria: Complete migration within 8 weeks with phased rollout
Achieve 50% query time reduction for top 20 queries
Maintain dashboard availability with zero downtime
Reduce storage footprint by 30% through compaction and Z-ordering
Full governance enabled via Unity Catalog

user_stories.title: Migrate existing Hive tables to Delta format with backward-compatible schema
user_stories.i_want: to convert all Hive tables to Delta Lake tables ensuring backward-compatible SQL queries
user_stories.so_that: existing BI dashboards and ETL jobs continue to run seamlessly during and after migration

acceptance_criteria.given: a Hive table with existing schema
acceptance_criteria.when: I convert it to Delta format using Databricks utilities
acceptance_criteria.then: the table should retain schema and support existing SELECT queries without modification

acceptance_criteria.given: running dashboards on Tableau or Looker
acceptance_criteria.when: data is migrated to Delta format
acceptance_criteria.then: dashboards should continue to refresh without errors or downtime

user_stories.title: Implement ACID transactions to ensure data consistency during concurrent writes
user_stories.i_want: to enable ACID transactions on Delta tables
user_stories.so_that: data consistency issues caused by concurrent writes are eliminated

acceptance_criteria.given: multiple ETL jobs writing to the same table
acceptance_criteria.when: Delta Lake transaction logs handle the writes
acceptance_criteria.then: data integrity should be maintained without conflicting records or corruption
Delta tables should maintain correct versioned data without missing or duplicated entries

user_stories.title: Enable time travel on Delta tables with 30-day retention
user_stories.i_want: to query historical versions of Delta tables using time travel
user_stories.so_that: I can audit and compare previous data states within the last 30 days

acceptance_criteria.given: a Delta table with version history
acceptance_criteria.when: I execute a query with a timestamp parameter
acceptance_criteria.then: the system should return the data snapshot as it existed at that time

acceptance_criteria.given: policy configuration for time travel retention
acceptance_criteria.then: older snapshots should be purged according to retention rules

user_stories.title: Optimize top 20 queries with Z-ordering and automatic compaction
user_stories.i_want: to implement Z-order indexing on frequently queried columns
user_stories.so_that: query performance improves by at least 50% for the top dashboards and reports

acceptance_criteria.when: Z-ordering is applied to relevant query columns
acceptance_criteria.then: query execution time should reduce by at least 50%
table storage usage should reduce by approximately 30%
